other_model_warning: These suggestions concern available memory. The models have not passed a complete paper-quality review. Results may vary with another model or quantisation.

tiers.title: Smaller local option
tiers.detail: A smaller download for Macs with less than 16 GB of unified memory. Memory use also depends on the context and other running apps.
tiers.quality_note: Review the questions and marking guidance before use. Fitting in memory does not establish accuracy.

tiers.title: Local option for 16 GB or more
tiers.detail: For Macs with at least 16 GB of unified memory. Close other memory-heavy apps before generating. Paper quality is still under review.
tiers.quality_note: Download size does not include all memory needed during generation.
